title: Social Media Content Creator (Reels & Graphic Designer)
Urgent Hiring: Graphic Designer (3+ Years Experience)
description:
We're Hiring: Graphic Designer (3 + Years' Experience) 
 Location: Vaishali, Ghaziabad 
 Experience: Minimum 3 Years 
 Employment Type: Full-Time (Work From Office) 
 Office Timing: 11:00 AM Onwards 
 Salary: 20,000 - 30,000 per month (Based on Skills & Experience) 
 About the Role We are looking for a creative and experienced graphic designer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate should have a strong eye for design, excellent communication skills, and the ability to create engaging visual content for digital and print media. 
 Required Skills Expert in Adobe Photoshop Strong knowledge of Figma Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator Experience with CorelDRAW AI-powered creative post design Social media post creation Banner, brochure, flyer, and marketing collateral design Logo and branding design Basic to advanced video editing UI/UX design knowledge is an added advantage 
 Preferred Tools Adobe InDesign Adobe Premiere Pro Adobe After Effects Canva Adobe Express AI design tools (Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, ChatGPT, etc.) 
 Requirements Minimum 3 years of professional experience in graphic design Strong portfolio showcasing creative and commercial work Excellent communication and presentation skills Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines Creative mindset with strong attention to detail Team player with a positive attitude and willingness to learn 
 What We Offer Salary: 20,000 30,000 per month (based on experience) Career growth opportunities Supportive and collaborative work environment Opportunity to work on diverse and exciting projects Continuous learning and skill development 
 Apply Now If you're passionate about design and want to create impactful visual experiences, we'd love to hear from you. 
 Send your updated resume and portfolio to: info.berservices@gmail.com

Key Skills: Graphic Designing,Visualiser,Video Editing,Motion Graphics,Creative Designing,Canva,Digital Marketing,HTML
